"""Intent tests for mdata.align_calendar: TC-02 (DATA-03) and TC-03 (DATA-04)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re

import pytest

import mdata
from mdata import Prices, RawRow


def _rows(raw: list[list]) -> list[RawRow]:
    return [RawRow(date=d, ticker=t, close=c) for d, t, c in raw]


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc02_one_calendar_with_filled_gaps(golden):
    inp, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-02")
    result = mdata.align_calendar(_rows(inp["rows"]), max_gap=inp["max_gap"])
    assert isinstance(result, Prices)
    assert result.dates == tuple(expected["dates"])
    assert result.tickers == tuple(expected["tickers"])
    assert set(result.closes) == set(expected["closes"])
    for ticker, closes in expected["closes"].items():
        assert tuple(result.closes[ticker]) == tuple(closes), ticker


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc02_default_max_gap_gives_same_answer(golden):
    inp, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-02")
    result = mdata.align_calendar(_rows(inp["rows"]))
    assert result.dates == tuple(expected["dates"])
    for ticker, closes in expected["closes"].items():
        assert tuple(result.closes[ticker]) == tuple(closes), ticker


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc03_six_date_gap_raises_gap_error_naming_ticker(golden):
    inp, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-03")
    assert expected["raises"] == "GapError"
    error = getattr(mdata, expected["raises"])
    with pytest.raises(error, match=re.escape(expected["match"])):
        mdata.align_calendar(_rows(inp["rows"]), max_gap=inp["max_gap"])

"""Intent tests for mdata.align_calendar: TC-02 (DATA-03) and TC-03 (DATA-04)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re

import pytest

import mdata
from mdata import Prices, RawRow


def _rows(raw: list[list]) -> list[RawRow]:
    return [RawRow(date=d, ticker=t, close=c) for d, t, c in raw]


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc02_one_calendar_with_filled_gaps(golden):
    inp, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-02")
    result = mdata.align_calendar(_rows(inp["rows"]), max_gap=inp["max_gap"])
    assert isinstance(result, Prices)
    assert result.dates == tuple(expected["dates"])
    assert result.tickers == tuple(expected["tickers"])
    assert set(result.closes) == set(expected["closes"])
    for ticker, closes in expected["closes"].items():
        assert tuple(result.closes[ticker]) == tuple(closes), ticker


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc02_default_max_gap_gives_same_answer(golden):
    inp, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-02")
    result = mdata.align_calendar(_rows(inp["rows"]))
    assert result.dates == tuple(expected["dates"])
    for ticker, closes in expected["closes"].items():
        assert tuple(result.closes[ticker]) == tuple(closes), ticker


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc03_six_date_gap_raises_gap_error_naming_ticker(golden):
    inp, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-03")
    assert expected["raises"] == "GapError"
    error = getattr(mdata, expected["raises"])
    with pytest.raises(error, match=re.escape(expected["match"])):
        mdata.align_calendar(_rows(inp["rows"]), max_gap=inp["max_gap"])


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc03_default_max_gap_is_five(golden):
    inp, expected = golden("mdata", "TC-03")
    with pytest.raises(mdata.GapError, match=re.escape(expected["match"])):
        mdata.align_calendar(_rows(inp["rows"]))


@pytest.mark.intent
def test_tc03_gap_within_a_larger_limit_is_filled(golden):
    inp, _ = golden("mdata", "TC-03")
    result = mdata.align_calendar(_rows(inp["rows"]), max_gap=inp["max_gap"] + 1)
    assert result.tickers == ("A", "B")
    assert len(result.closes["B"]) == len(result.dates)
    assert all(c > 0 for c in result.closes["B"])
